messages:
jessica-customer-success: FYI AcmeCorp reporting a spike of 504s from hosted API since ~08:12 PDT. Ticket CS-4821 attached. They pasted a curl that times out.

jessica-customer-success: curl -v https://api.redwood.dev/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' -d '{\"input\":\"hello\"}'  

tara-support: ack, looking. Do we have tenant id + recent deploys?

infra-bot: [alert] prod-hosted-gateway: rate=crit queue_depth=2250 continuous_batcher_backlog=1800 p95_latency=2100ms

devon-eng: I see a sharp rise in request_queue_depth for tenant acme (tenant_id=acme-001) starting 08:10. continuous-batcher backlog growing, KV cache miss-rate also climbing.

mike-sre: can you paste the relevant metrics queries you used?

devon-eng: queries I ran:
```
sum(rate(redwood_ingress_requests_total{env="prod",tenant="acme-001",code="504"}[2m]))
max_over_time(redwood_batcher_queue_depth{env="prod"}[5m])
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(redwood_batcher_latency_seconds_bucket{env="prod"}[5m])) by (le))
```

devon-eng: logs show repeated entries like:
`WARN enqueue_delay_ms=4300 queue_depth=2001 tenant=acme-001 handler=ingress-gateway`

tara-support: Customer says they didn't change traffic pattern, but our telemetry shows a sudden spike in concurrent long-prompt jobs. Could be a client-side retry storm.

sarah.ops: No recent infra deploys in the last 3 hours. Billing/auth system green. No token errors for acme.

mike-sre: immediate mitigation plan: 1) enable per-tenant rate cap for acme -> drop to 400rps, 2) reduce continuous-batcher target_batch_size from 64 -> 32 to lower queueing, 3) add a short-lived canary route to a secondary pool.

devon-eng: I can toggle the per-tenant throttle via admin-api now. Running:
```
curl -X POST https://admin.internal/tenants/acme-001/throttle -H 'Authorization: Bearer admin-token' -d '{"rps":400, "reason":"incident 1748001234"}'
```

infra-bot: action executed: tenant throttle set for acme-001 -> rps=400 by devon-eng at 08:32

devon-eng: reduced p95 504s within 3m. queue_depth dropped from 2200 -> 420. Continuous-batcher backlog decaying.

tara-support: updated CS ticket CS-4821 with temporary throttle and ask customer to backoff retries.

sarah.ops: follow-ups: 1) add alert for continuous_batcher_backlog_growth > 500 for >2m, 2) add tenant-specific retry-shedding recommendation to runbook, 3) investigate KV warmup to avoid miss storms, 4) customer postmortem meeting.

devon-eng: reproduced locally with a repro script: `scripts/repro/spike_ingress.sh --tenant acme-001 --rps 1200 --duration 10m` — will add to incident notes.

jessica-customer-success: Customer accepted temporary throttle, will throttle client side and schedule a follow-up call tomorrow.

mike-sre: closing on-call part of incident. Please file RCA ticket with timeline and config diffs. Mark resolved when RCA and runbook updates are in.

tara-support: resolved for now, will monitor 24h. :white_check_mark:
